title: IcePaHC — Icelandic Parsed Historical Corpus
notes: IcePaHC is the Iceland Parsed Historical Corpus treebank (Old/Norse-to-modern Icelandic span, texts 1350-1750+ for pre-1700), distributed on GitHub as .psd/.tagged/.txt files. The 21 RQ files (bandamenn, ectorssaga, judit, vilhjalmur etc.) match the corpus .txt files exactly. Free public release; the linguist.is wiki site returned HTTP 511 from two networks, so the verified live canonical entry point is the GitHub repo. RQ collected from the raw txt layer (word-level parses dropped). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Joel C. Wallenberg (York), Anton Karl Ingason & Einar Freyr Sigurðsson (Árni Magnússon Institute/HI, Iceland), Eiríkur Rögnvaldsson; version 2024.03
